purpose: Create a club with valid leadership and faculty assignments.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized; valid student and faculty identity records are available.
action_or_input: Enter the club name and description, select an allowed category, select valid coordinator and co-coordinator students and a valid Club Faculty Councillor, then submit.
expected_result: The system validates the assignments, creates the club with open status, and confirms successful creation.

purpose: Ensure invalid leader or faculty assignments can be corrected without creating a club.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized; at least one selected leader or faculty record is invalid.
action_or_input: Submit a new club with the invalid assignment, then correct the assignment.
expected_result: The system identifies the invalid assignment, allows correction, and does not create the club before valid assignments are supplied.

purpose: Ensure a storage failure does not create a partial club record.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized; valid club data is available; required data storage fails.
action_or_input: Submit the valid new club record while storage is unavailable.
expected_result: The club is not created and the system reports failure.

purpose: Book a valid club session without a conflicting booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; selected venue is configured; no session or event overlaps the requested slot at that venue and date.
action_or_input: Select the venue and date, enter a start time before the end time and the session description, optionally add a poster, then submit.
expected_result: The system validates the time range, checks sessions and events for conflicts, stores the session, initiates notification to intended student recipients, and confirms the booking.

purpose: Reject a session that overlaps an existing session or event.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; a session or event exists at the same venue and date with an overlapping time.
action_or_input: Submit a session booking whose time overlaps the existing booking.
expected_result: The system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

purpose: Ensure invalid venue, invalid time range, or pre-acceptance storage or notification failure does not result in a successful session booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; one of the specified invalid venue, invalid time range, storage failure, or notification failure conditions applies.
action_or_input: Submit the session booking under the applicable failure condition.
expected_result: No successful session booking is recorded.

purpose: Book a valid club event without a conflicting booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; selected venue is configured; faculty context is valid as applicable; no session or event overlaps the requested slot at that venue and date.
action_or_input: Enter event name and faculty context, select venue and date, enter a start time before the end time, poster, and description, then submit.
expected_result: The system validates faculty context as applicable and the time range, checks sessions and events for conflicts, stores the event, initiates notification to intended student recipients, and confirms the booking.

purpose: Reject an event that overlaps an existing session or event.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; a session or event exists at the same venue and date with an overlapping time.
action_or_input: Submit an event booking whose time overlaps the existing booking.
expected_result: The system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

purpose: Ensure invalid venue, faculty reference, time range, or event storage does not result in a successful event booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; club is confirmed; one of the specified invalid venue, faculty reference, time range, or storage failure conditions applies.
action_or_input: Submit the event booking under the applicable failure condition.
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

purpose: Submit a membership application to a confirmed club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; selected club exists and is confirmed; student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Select the confirmed club, enter achievements or an application description, and submit.
expected_result: The system identifies the authenticated student, records a new application with open status, and confirms submission.

purpose: Allow a student with an existing application to apply to a different club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; student has an application to one club; a different club exists and is confirmed.
action_or_input: Apply to the different confirmed club.
expected_result: The system creates an open application to the different club.

purpose: Reject a duplicate application to the same club without changing the existing application.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; selected club is confirmed; the student already has an application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit another application to the same club.
expected_result: The system rejects the duplicate and leaves the existing application unchanged.

purpose: Approve a pending membership application for the applicable club.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; an open application exists for the club.
action_or_input: Select the open application, optionally enter remarks, and approve it.
expected_result: The system validates the application and actor authorization, changes status from open to confirmed, stores remarks if entered, and confirms approval.

purpose: Approve multiple selected pending applications independently.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; multiple open applications exist for the club.
action_or_input: Select multiple open applications and approve them in one interaction.
expected_result: Each selected application is evaluated independently; applications eligible for approval are confirmed.

purpose: Leave an application unchanged if it is no longer open or does not belong to the actor's club.
preconditions: Actor is a Club Head; a selected application is either no longer open or belongs to another club.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the selected application.
expected_result: The application is not changed.

purpose: Create a poll with at least two choices and notify its selected target audience.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; valid batch and branch target information is available.
action_or_input: Enter poll title, description, expiry date, at least two choices, and target groups by batch and branch, then submit.
expected_result: The system validates the definition, determines the target audience, creates the poll and choices, notifies students in the selected groups, and confirms creation.

purpose: Use the configured all-branches target option for a selected batch.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; the all-branches option is configured for a selected batch.
action_or_input: Create a poll and select the configured all-branches option for that batch.
expected_result: The target selection represents all branches for the selected batch.

purpose: Reject a poll with fewer than two choices or invalid target information.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator; poll input has fewer than two choices or invalid target information.
action_or_input: Submit the poll with the specified invalid choice count or target information.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

purpose: Record one vote from an eligible student in an active poll.
preconditions: Student is authenticated, belongs to a target group, poll is active and unexpired, and student has not voted in it.
action_or_input: Select one poll choice and submit the vote.
expected_result: The system verifies eligibility and prior voting, records the vote, updates the tally, records that the student has voted, and confirms voting.

purpose: Reject a duplicate, ineligible, or inactive-poll vote without changing the tally.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; at least one applies: student already voted, student is not eligible, or poll is not active.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The system rejects the vote and leaves the tally unchanged.

purpose: Change club coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
preconditions: Actor is an applicable current Club Head; club exists; proposed leaders are valid students.
action_or_input: Identify the club and proposed leaders, then submit the leadership change.
expected_result: The system retrieves current assignments, updates the club to the new coordinator and co-coordinator, records the new current designations, retires superseded current designations, and confirms the change.

purpose: Preserve current leadership when a proposed leader is invalid or the actor is unauthorized.
preconditions: Club exists; either a proposed leader is invalid or the actor is unauthorized.
action_or_input: Attempt to change club leadership.
expected_result: The system leaves current leadership unchanged.

purpose: Submit a valid club budget request for tracking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head; club exists and is confirmed; required file storage is available.
action_or_input: Enter purpose, a non-negative amount, upload the required supporting file, enter a description, and submit.
expected_result: The system validates amount and file presence, stores the request with open status for tracking, and confirms submission.

purpose: Reject a budget request with a negative amount or missing required file.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head; club exists and is confirmed; request has a negative amount or lacks the required file.
action_or_input: Submit the request with the specified invalid amount or missing file.
expected_result: The request is rejected and is not stored as a valid submission.

purpose: Submit a complete report for a completed club event.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head; relevant event or activity has occurred; required references and file are available.
action_or_input: Identify the club and student incharge, enter event name, description, date and time, upload the required report/details file, and submit.
expected_result: The system validates required information and file, stores the event report, and confirms submission.

purpose: Reject an event report with a missing report file or invalid or missing required references.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable Club Head; report input lacks the required file or has invalid or missing required references.
action_or_input: Submit the incomplete or invalid event report.
expected_result: The report is not accepted.

purpose: Approve an open club as Student Admin.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized; club exists with open status.
action_or_input: Open and review the club record and assignments, then approve the club.
expected_result: The system changes club status from open to confirmed and confirms approval.

purpose: Ensure a club that is not open or cannot be updated does not transition to approved.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized; club is not open or the club record cannot be updated.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club.
expected_result: No approval transition occurs.

purpose: Allow the assigned Club Faculty Councillor to access and review a submitted report.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated and is the assigned Club Faculty Councillor; at least one submitted report is available for the assigned club.
action_or_input: Open the club report area, select a report, and request its metadata and report/details file.
expected_result: The system lists submitted reports for the assigned club and makes selected report metadata and file available for review.

purpose: Deny report access to a faculty user not assigned to the club.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated but is not the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for the club.
action_or_input: Attempt to access the club's submitted reports.
expected_result: The system denies access and exposes no unauthorized report content.
